d.ko: 입질 기다리기가 너무 지루하시다구요? 제발 고기를 좀 잡고 싶으시다구요? 운이 좋으시네요 - Ultimate Fishing Simulator에서는, 미친 듯이 달려듭니다! 스피닝 낚시, 찌 낚시, 바닥 낚시 그리고 더더더!
d.en: Bored of waiting for a bite? Would you like to catch some fish? You're lucky - in Ultimate Fishing Simulator, fish bite like crazy! Spinning, float fishing, ground fishing, and more! Comprehensive fishing simulator that allows using various techniques, in different places around the world!
